title: Consent banner: 44 px tap targets that do not bleed
description: Issue #5186 gave the privacy link a 44 px hit area with py-3.5 -my-3.5, and Devin Review caught the overlap: at 390 px a tap inside the padded link lands on Allow analytics. Compare the padded link with the real inline-flex min-h-11 box, and measure both hit areas in the DOM.
